# Third-party origin

`merge-mansion-api/` and `merge-mansion-dumper/` originate from
https://github.com/mm-utils/merge-mansion-dumper (GPL-3.0), upstream commit `3d1803d` (2026-02-24, game version 26.02.01),
imported into MergeMansionWikiTools on 2026-03-02 and modified since. The upstream license text is in `LICENSE.upstream`.
These directories are being replaced by the in-house `MMWT.Dumper` (see `_CONTEXT/_plans/2026-09-06-native-dumper-design.md`).
